description: Input module bringing line level signals into the rack, with a waveshaping enhance stage, an envelope follower, a comparator and footswitch outputs

params.text: Sets the gain of the stereo line input, roughly unity fully anticlockwise and about +40dB fully clockwise
Sets how hard the enhance input is driven into the soft clipping and filtering stage
Nothing in the module reads this control; the plugin links to no audio device, so there is no microphone signal for it to set the sensitivity of
Picks what is normalled to the enhance and follow inputs: up a mono sum of the stereo line input, centre nothing at all, down the microphone
Sets the envelope follower's response, linear on the left and a logarithmic attack with exponential release on the right
Adds to the attack time of the generated envelope, slewing at about 1V per second at its slowest
Adds to the release time of the generated envelope, slewing at about 1V per second at its slowest
Sets the voltage the follower signal has to pass before the comparator gate goes high
Sets the length of the trigger fired by the A footswitch, 5ms to 500ms
Flips the state of the B gate output and holds it there

inputs.text: The stereo line input, split to the left and right outputs and available as a mono sum to the enhance and follow stages
The signal into the waveshaping stage, which breaks the normal set by the source toggle
The signal read by the envelope follower and the comparator, which breaks the normal set by the source toggle
Takes the dual footswitch, whose A and B switches drive the trigger and gate outputs

outputs.text: The right side of the stereo line input, at modular level
The left side of the stereo line input at modular level, carrying a mono sum of both sides while the right output is unpatched
The enhance input after soft clipping, non-linear shaping and gentle filtering
A gate held high while the follower signal is above the comparator threshold
A unipolar positive envelope following the level of the follower signal
A unipolar negative envelope following the level of the follower signal
A trigger fired when the A footswitch is pressed, at the length set by DURATION
A gate held high for as long as the A footswitch is pressed
A gate held high for as long as the B footswitch is pressed, and flipped by the latching button
